description: Aurobindo Pharma Limited, a biopharmaceutical company, develops, manufactures, commercializes, and sells generic pharmaceuticals, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), and injectables. The company offers formulation in form of oral solids, liquids, injectables, vaccines, and metered dose inhalers; and APIs, biosimilars, and peptides targeting therapeutic areas, such as central nervous system, cardiovascular, respiratory, antibiotics, anti-retroviral, anti-diabetics, gastroenterology, oncology, and dermatology.
